items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution for new launches, experiments, monetization changes, and spend. Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; the $4.92 is not site-attributable because it is in an aggregate row. AI usage cost is $922.381 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 5,048 calls, including 229 errors. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, AI payback, infrastructure burden, budget capacity, and forecasts are not calculable because revenue and AI costs cover different periods, matching-period infrastructure/labor/other costs are absent, budget ceilings and commitments are blank, and no approved learning threshold or experiment-to-revenue linkage exists. Do not treat missing values as zero. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation and measurement work; preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed. SEO totals and productivity outcomes are operating or vanity indicators, not revenue or margin evidence.

The containment recommendation is financially supported. Retain the existing finance reconciliation work item only; do not create duplicate finance requests. Minimum required artifact: reconcile all 18 named tracking rows and the aggregate row against matching-period revenue, AI cost, infrastructure cost, labor and other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and an explicit cost-to-learn threshold. Until complete, reject site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget-capacity, forecast, and causal-lift claims. The three site-factory candidates should remain deferred on financial grounds as well as their stated ownership and launch gates.
